decks.notes: This deck focuses on generating mana quickly through the use of Lotus Field and various untap effects, allowing the player to cast powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game in a single explosive turn. The deck includes cards that help find key pieces of the combo, protect against disruption, and provide alternate win conditions if the primary combo is disrupted. The strategy revolves around efficiently ramping up mana production and deploying game-winning spells in quick succession.

This combo deck aims to quickly assemble the pieces needed to Transmogrify creatures into powerful creatures like Mirrex or Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck includes ways to protect the combo, disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, and generate additional value with cards like Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Tribute to Horobi. The key strategy is to set up a board state where the opponent is overwhelmed by the powerful creatures that can quickly close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a strong devotion to green mana by utilizing mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic combined with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. This enables ramping up to powerful green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and mana with cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival. Additionally, there are utility cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures to provide flexibility and resilience against opposing strategies.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive play, utilizing powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser to put pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand and removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to handle threats. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to ensure victory in the late game. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of creatures and spells.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cheap spells and use cards like Pieces of the Puzzle and Treasure Cruise to draw into more spells, allowing for the quick reanimation of Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck also includes removal spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board while charting a course to victory with aggressive plays and efficient card draw. Additionally, cards like Temporal Trespass and Galvanic Iteration provide extra value and potential for explosive turns.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize tempo plays and aggressive creatures to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent. By playing efficient spirits like Rattlechains and Mausoleum Wanderer along with disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while also countering key spells. Cards like Curious Obsession and Supreme Phantom help to further enhance the aggro strategy, with support from counter spells like Lofty Denial. The inclusion of utility lands and additional support cards provide both consistency and flexibility in different game scenarios.

This deck focuses on utilizing green mana symbols for devotion to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck includes mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to accelerate mana production, while Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven provide additional mana sources. The deck also includes powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Lair of the Hydra to pressure the opponent. Karn, the Great Creator offers utility with artifact tutoring, while Storm the Festival helps maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overpower the opponent with big creatures.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Claim the Firstborn, it aims to control the board and apply pressure. The deck also includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, for additional flexibility and utility. By combining aggressive creature plays with sacrifice effects, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and close out games quickly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan and ensure consistent casting of spells.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to create a fast and aggressive board presence. The deck includes low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Thraben Inspector, supported by buffs from cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon. The deck also features removal options with cards like Skyclave Apparition and Giant Killer. In addition, it includes some utility cards like Legion's Landing for additional creatures and Shefet Dunes for a potential boost in power. Overall, the focus is on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of efficient creatures and utilizing various tools for board control.

The key concept of this deck revolves around aggressive gameplay and sacrificing creatures for value. The deck utilizes the Rakdos color combination to maximize damage output and control the board state. Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar are key cards that generate value through sacrificing creatures and dealing damage to opponents. The inclusion of cards like Claim the Firstborn and Shrapnel Blast allows for additional control and burst damage. The deck also features various lands and artifacts to support its strategy, including Castle Locthwain, Deadly Dispute, and Experimental Synthesizer. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and strategic sacrifices.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a focus on sacrificing creatures for benefits, utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Claim the Firstborn. It also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's game plan. The deck's mana base includes key lands like Blood Crypt and Den of the Bugbear to support the aggressive playstyle. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds extra value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. It uses cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Dovin's Veto to control the board while digging for answers with Memory Deluge and Castle Vantress. Shark Typhoon provides a win condition while Hall of Storm Giants offers a late-game threat. Field of Ruin helps deal with problematic lands and Absorb provides additional counterspells. The deck also includes some removal spells like Make Disappear and March of Otherworldly Light to stay in control of the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using hand disruption and removal spells to control the game while deploying aggressive threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The mana base is built to support a mix of black and red spells, with utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear to provide additional value. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games quickly.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game quickly. With a mix of removal spells and evasive creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and take control of the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Reckless Stormseeker to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes powerful enchantments like The Akroan War and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to control the board and maximize damage output. With mana ramp provided by cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while utilizing Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. The land base is optimized for consistent and efficient mana production to support the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Mirrex and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It includes cards like Tribute to Horobi and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to support this combo strategy. The goal is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to bring out these game-winning creatures while using disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Warping Wail to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck.
